codeReview.summary: The worker correctly identified that the cone mesh generation code was already correct and that the test's expected value was wrong. The fix changes the assertion from 52 to 36 and corrects the comment. The vertex count math is verified: 1 apex + 17 side ring (0..=16) + 1 bottom center + 17 bottom ring (0..=16) = 36. The old comment claimed this sum was 52, which was an arithmetic error in the test. The change is minimal (2 lines), correct, and all 5 cone tests pass along with the full workspace test suite.

sharedStateObservations.observation: services.yaml has test-gfx command (cargo test -p katla_gfx) but the handoff shows the worker ran 'cargo test -p katla_gfx test_cone_vertex_count' manually. The services.yaml command pattern is sufficient but could include a note about running individual tests.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: services.yaml line with 'test-gfx: cargo test -p katla_gfx' vs handoff verification commands using 'cargo test -p katla_gfx test_cone_vertex_count'
